source: public issues of omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace, maintainer review comments
classification: one reader, by the reviewer's own wording, one class per finding

classes.inWords: absolute deadline, cancel on destruction, process-group cleanup, no reap of the leader before TERM then KILL, job limit released only after reap
byte and line bounds on the producer side; clipping after onExited does not count
private 0700 directory, no-follow descriptor, size cap, 0600 exclusive temp, atomic replace, schema-validated parse, no check-then-use
fixed absolute helper paths instead of PATH resolution, minimal environment, curl -q
never in argv, never in logs or notifications, protected at rest
pinned refs, checksums, no self-update from the network, provenance for bundled binaries
HTTPS only, refuse private addresses, pin the redirect origin
argv only, strict grammar and length on values that end up in a command
docker or input group membership is root-equivalent and must be named as such

notes: Shares are rounded to whole percent and sum to 92 because a few findings fit no class. Individual findings are not reproduced; the issue numbers are the sample, the classes are the aggregate.
